gold: Juvenile spring eruption (JSE) associated with parvovirus B19 infection

selector.rationale: The presence of serum parvovirus B19 IgM and IgG antibodies, PVB19 DNA in lesional skin biopsy, and the clinical presentation of an intensely pruritic skin eruption with numerous small blisters support Erythema multiforme as the most likely diagnosis.

rejected.label: Gianotti-Crosti syndrome
rejected.why: While it shares some clinical features, the presence of PVB19 DNA and specific antibodies points more strongly towards Erythema multiforme.

rejected.label: Phototoxic reaction
rejected.why: Standard phototesting with UV-A and UV-B was unremarkable, contradicting the diagnosis of a phototoxic reaction.
